newsitem.title: BELGIUM: OLO/Bund spread seen widening, mood gloomy.
newsitem.headline: OLO/Bund spread seen widening, mood gloomy.

text.p: Belgian linear bonds and futures closed off day lows on Thursday, consolidating Tuesday's and Wednesday's gains, but dealers said the mood was gloomy and that the market needed to pause for breath.

The OLO futures contract closed four bp lower at 119.80 after falling as low as 119.67. The 2006 OLO yield closed at 6.05 percent, up one bp. Its yield premium ended unchaged at 13 bp, but touched 15 in the afternoon.
Several dealers said they expected the spread to widen towards 20 bp. "We may see some buyers again when it hits 17," one said.
"There is a negative feeling in the market. The buyers are on strike," one dealer said.
Money market yields ended virtually unchanged, with three-month T-bill yields at 3.03/06, from 3.05/07.
